mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic properties; amantadine has moderate anticholinergic activity while scopolamine is a potent anticholinergic agent, resulting in additive anticholinergic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor closely for anticholinergic toxicity including urinary retention, constipation, tachycardia, hyperthermia, confusion, and hallucinations; consider alternative agents if possible.
